properties.state: {"description":"A core test over the compiled schema: every edge type has a `reading`; its primitive (or every component of its composition) is in the declared primitive set; every modifier kind is in the declared modifier-kind set; every property named as a modifier is declared on that edge; basis is `classified` or `reviewed`.
